personality.description: This person tends to generate fresh ideas quickly, explore unusual possibilities, and stay open to changing plans on the fly. In daily habits, they are social, talkative, and enthusiastic, but also somewhat disorganized and prone to postponing details or missing deadlines when structure is lacking. When faced with a moral dilemma, they usually want to do what feels fair and thoughtful, yet anxiety can make them overthink consequences and revisit the issue repeatedly before settling on a choice. In group discussions, they speak readily and energetically, often introducing novel viewpoints, while still standing firm on their own opinions when they believe it matters.
